title: AI-assisted macaque cortex atlas reveals regional cell-type organization
summary: AI-assisted segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped map 264 transcriptome-defined cell types across the macaque cortex. Regional cell-type composition tracked cortical hierarchy, and cross-species comparisons identified primate-specific types enriched in layer 4. This is the July 12, 2023 journal version; the atlas is observational, uses male monkeys, and has limited transcript capture per spatial cell.
ai_technology: AI-assisted cell segmentation; Spatial-ID (deep neural network and graph convolutional network)
organization: Chinese Academy of Sciences; BGI-Research; Tencent AI Lab

evidence.tested: New macaque tissue measurements and spatial maps were compared across sections and biological replicates; this supports a bounded anatomical result, not causal brain function.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: independent replication and exhaustive supplementary material. The paper identifies limited transcript sensitivity and absence of female subjects.
evidence.ai_role: Image segmentation identifies cells; Spatial-ID trains a DNN on nucleus profiles and a GCN incorporating spatial neighborhoods to assign spatial cell labels.
